prediction_text: 脱欧成真：2016年6月23日公投，『脱离』一方胜出，英国投票离开欧盟——民调领先的『留欧』将被逆转，脱欧以微弱多数过关。
basis:
tradition: The card has no tradition/system field; by genre (a mundane election forecast from the UK national charts) decided as western mundane astrology.
systems_used: western astrology (mundane; UK national charts)
Indicator chain: The setting supplies the decisive transit: on referendum day Uranus and Ceres conjunct at 23° Aries — Uranus is rupture and sudden reversal, and a conjunction perfecting on the very day of the vote acts on the vote's outcome, not on the campaign. The available national charts (1066, 1801, 1922) place the UK identity under this Aries-point pressure. Polls showing 'Stay' ahead with vast 'not sure' numbers are a soft background fact, outweighed by a dated disruptive configuration: late-deciding voters break toward rupture. Direction: Leave wins, narrowly (a rupture vote carried by late deciders does not produce a landslide). Object: the referendum result itself, as asked.

The dated exact configuration outranks the snapshot poll; band set at a narrow Leave win (suppression line caps the margin, grounds stated).
主线认定：The referendum-day Uranus conjunction line is the working main line (exact, directly on the outcome, state ranked first); the margin band follows the poll suppression line.
